_rules: Prompts are written the way a homeowner would type them. Groups A-H never mention membership, subscription or Profixter: they measure whether an AI introduces the recurring model on its own.
Do not edit an existing prompt's wording - that breaks comparison with earlier runs. Add new prompts with new ids instead.
baselineId is the id used in the October 8, 2026 audit run (scripts/ai-benchmark/baseline/2026-10-08.json).
